title: ORCHESTRATE-1: the tick Worker plans, fans out, reviews and integrates items the single-shot executor fails
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** an item whose blocker starts with 'needs-code: worker-native attempt failed'
**Done check:** grep:seed/worker/src/executor.js::orchestrateProvider
**Closing probe:** node --test seed/worker/test/orchestrate.test.js
**Prediction:** orch_runs_done >= 1 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** running code in a sandbox before the PR and a paid model rung (OL-20261126-1)
**Status:** open

A run kept in D1 (orch_runs, orch_steps) advances one phase a tick: plan, implement in parallel, verify with a model that wrote no step, fix, integrate as one PR. Code seed/worker/src/orchestrate.js.
